description:
The Professional Software Engineer is a position within Dematic’s Lifecycle Solutions & Services Software Engineering organization responsible for delivering software solutions as part of customer project teams. The role independently develops, implements, integrates, tests, troubleshoots, and supports software solutions for automated warehouse systems while applying technical and domain knowledge to engineering decisions and issue resolution. 

The position actively contributes to software and system design discussions, takes ownership of assigned software solutions and technical outcomes, and collaborates with customers and cross-functional teams to support successful project execution and create customer value. 

The role provides opportunities for continued growth within the Software Engineering career path through deeper technical and domain expertise, broader solution and project ownership, and developing technical and/or project leadership capabilities. 

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $ 76,500 - 105,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills. 
 We offer: 
 Key Responsibilities: 

 Participate as a key member of project teams delivering software modifications, enhancements, retrofits, and upgrades to automated warehouse systems.  
 Independently develop, configure, implement, integrate, and test software solutions, taking ownership of assigned solutions and technical deliverables.  
 Work with customers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, evaluate technical needs, and actively contribute to software and system design decisions.  
 Conduct unit and integration testing and participate in on-site commissioning and system validation to ensure solutions meet defined project and customer requirements.  
 Drive software debugging and troubleshooting within assigned project scope, coordinating issue resolution and engaging other technical resources when appropriate.  
 Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to communicate progress, identify risks, coordinate technical activities and assigned deliverables, and support successful project execution. 
 Participate in code and design reviews, providing technical feedback and sharing knowledge with project team members.  
 Develop and maintain software and system documentation, including technical specifications, user guides, and job aids.  
 Provide standby and post-implementation software support as assigned, driving issue resolution within the engineer’s area of responsibility.  
 Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to less-experienced engineers and take on increasing responsibility for technical coordination, customer communication, and project deliverables as experience and capability develop. 
 Other responsibilities as required. 
 
 Skills & Capabilities: 

 Proficiency in one or more programming languages and the ability to learn and apply new technologies. Relevant technologies include C/C++, C#, VB.NET, JavaScript, and TypeScript.  
 Working knowledge of software development environments and tools, including Windows/Linux, web technologies, Git/TFS version control, and debugging tools.  
 Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; relevant technologies include Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.  
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical issues and contribute to solution design.  
 Proactive and self-motivated, demonstrating ownership of software solutions and sound judgment in seeking guidance or escalating issues.  
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to customers and cross-functional teams.  
 Team-oriented with the ability to collaborate, share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and develop technical and/or project leadership capabilities. 
 
 Experience Desired: 

 Five or more years of experience in software engineering, software development, industrial automation, material handling, or a related technical field is desired.    
 Experience independently developing, implementing, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting software solutions in a project or customer delivery environment.    
 Experience owning software solutions or technical deliverables through implementation, integration, testing, and commissioning.    
 Experience interpreting customer and project requirements and contributing to software or system design decisions.    
 Experience participating in code reviews, design reviews, or other collaborative technical review activities.    
 Experience collaborating directly with customers and cross-functional teams to support technical decisions and successful project execution.    
 Experience providing technical guidance or coordinating engineering activities within a project team is beneficial.    
 Experience with industrial automation, material handling, automated warehouse systems, or integrated software and control systems is preferred. 
 
 Education & Certifications: 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent education, training, or relevant experience may be considered.    
 No specific professional certifications are required. 
 
 
 Tasks and Qualifications: 
 Additional Job Details and Information:

 Domestic travel up to 25% required.    
 Ability to work in customer warehouses and industrial environments as required.    
 Follow applicable customer-site and Dematic health and safety requirements.    
 Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment based on characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.    
 Qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.    
 Reasonable accommodations will be considered for qualified individuals in accordance with applicable law.
